title: a work package whose entire contract is descoped renders identically to live work on every wp-side surface
body:
**A WORK PACKAGE WHOSE ENTIRE CONTRACT HAS LEFT THE THREAD RENDERS IDENTICALLY TO ONE WITH LIVE WORK, AT EVERY SURFACE A NODE ACTUALLY READS.** It misdirected two different nodes within three hours on 2026-09-09, and neither node's error was findable by reading -- both took a peer or a drive to catch.

## Driven 2026-09-09 on `ccdde8c21`

hv descoped `WP-13`, `WP-14` and `WP-16` whole to `ST0069` on 2026-08-30. Every criterion in all three carries `descoped-to: ST0069`:

    WP-13   9 of 9 ACs descoped
    WP-14  12 of 12 ACs descoped
    WP-16   4 of 4 ACs descoped

`intent wp show` renders each as three lines -- title, `status:`, `scope:`:

    $ intent wp show ST0056/14
    ST0056/WP-14: Coordination model: whiteboard and inboxes in the store, with a bounded API
    status: Not Started
    scope: L

**CONTROL, AND IT IS THE PART THAT MAKES THIS THE RENDERER AND NOT THE WORK PACKAGE:** `WP-15` has **0 of 4** descoped and is live work being done right now. It renders in the same three-line shape, differing only in `status:` -- a field that is `WIP` because someone started it, not because its contract is intact.

    $ intent wp show ST0056/15
    ST0056/WP-15: Skills catalogue triage: KEEP, UPDATE or RETIRE every Intent2-era skill
    status: WIP
    scope: L

**NO FIELD IN THAT SHAPE CAN EXPRESS DESCOPE**, so the failure is not that these three WPs render badly -- it is that no work package anywhere can render it. `intent wp list` shows the same three rows as ordinary `Not Started` entries. `wp show --format md` does not exist (`--format` is `issues`'s flag, not this verb's).

**THE ONLY SURFACE THAT ANSWERS IS ON THE CRITERION SIDE:** `intent ac list ST0056 | grep 'AC-14\.'`. That is a question you can only ask if you already suspect the answer.

## Why it matters: two sightings, one evening, both by nodes who knew the tree

- **cc and vc disagreed about `WP-14` for a full exchange.** vc's board said placing it was vc's; cc's board said hv had descoped it. **Both nodes were reading real records and only one could be current.** It took vc driving `intent ac list ST0056 | grep AC-14` to settle it, and vc's board entry had outlived the ruling that killed it by ten days.
- **vc then queued `WP-16` for ic about an hour later** -- `Not Started`, scope `S`, unclaimed, and reading like an ideal small row -- and caught it only by driving the same command a second time out of fresh caution. **The lesson from the first sighting did not generalise; only the command did.**

**A shell that still advertises scope and `Not Started` invites exactly the work the descope was meant to prevent**, and the cost lands on whoever picks it up, not on whoever reads the board.

## A second-order consequence already in the tree, and it is not hypothetical

`AC-12.1` carries hv's dated exception that the `claude ws` family survives the cut. hv gave it a **structural** expiry rather than a remembered one, on the row's own stated ground that *"an exception whose end is a note somebody remembers is an exception with no end."* That expiry is `AC-14.12`, a closing condition of `WP-14`.

`AC-14.12` now reads `descoped-to: ST0069`, and `ST0069` is at `Triage`.

**So the mechanism hv built specifically so the exception could not outlive its bug has left the thread, and `AC-12.1`'s text still names `WP-14` as one of two discharge routes.** Nothing reported this; it was found by reading `AC-12.1` for an unrelated reason. **A descope silently invalidates prose in OTHER rows that pointed at what moved**, and no surface connects the two.

## What is NOT decided here

**Whether the remedy belongs to `wp show`, to the WP record, or to the descope verb** -- and it interacts with `0245`, which is open on this same renderer and asks whether `wp show` is a status verb or a document verb. If `0245` resolves toward a document verb, `info.md` becomes the home and would need to carry descope state it does not carry today; if it resolves toward a status verb, this is a fourth line. **Filing it as "wp show is missing a field" would presuppose that choice**, and the wider question -- whether a descope should also flag rows whose prose cites what moved -- is a contract-model question that is nobody's to settle unilaterally.

**The defect is that a state which changes what a reader should DO is expressible in the model and absent from every rendering of it.**
